sources.snippet: The only model-specific pieces on the export side are the Nemotron-H squared-ReLU MLP (Cosmos3ReasonerCausalLM) and the mapping from the checkpoint’s native flat schema to the shared decoder names.

sources.title: NVIDIA Releases Cosmos 3 Edge: A 4B-Parameter Open World Model That ...
sources.snippet: NVIDIA has released Cosmos 3 Edge, a 4-billion-parameter open world model built to run on-device. It helps robots and vision AI agents understand surroundings, reason in real time, and generate robot actions locally.
